parts.text: Limerence enters her lab, running through the usual routines, turning on lights.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Dear.. I'm hooooome~

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: How has my darling been?

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Is the anti septic comfortable? It's not too irritating, is it?

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: I know I shouldn't, but I just can't help but spoil my precious when he's not comfy.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: I can lower the concentration if it's bothering you too much.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Not… too much though… I'm sorry baby.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: I know… I know... I've been coming home later and later. I'm sorry love, it's just- all the work has been piling up lately… and…

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Well, it's all worth it in the end when I can see you after a hard day's work. Hehe~

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: I got to run by the market though on the way back! Blueberries, your favorite.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Would that make it all better~?

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Look at me…

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: talking to a dead corpse like an insane person.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: But they're the insane ones for thinking I'll just give up on you.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Every “I'm sorry”… every “my condolences for your loss…” UGH, IT DRIVES ME INSANE.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: I- I'm sorry for yelling love… I… I don't want you to ever feel a fraction of what they put me through…

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Telling me all those platitudes… Evelyn would never approve of this.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: If she found out I gave them a fake body and kept yours in secret…

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: …no. I don't want to think of what would happen if anyone found out.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: *Nobody* can find out about this… not until you're alive again.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Why… why did you have to try saving them?

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: It was just *one* imaginary friend, we had it under control.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: You could still *be* here… but you ran in to help without a second thought.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: That… heart. That damn heart of yours.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: It's what made me fall in love with you…

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: and it's what got you killed.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Stupid… stupid… STUPID. You're so stupid you know that?!

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Making me drag your dead body back to the others, making me lie about burying you…

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: making me pick up the pieces of your shattered object.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Imanagination… It's such a strange yet powerful substance.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: I've been trying to inject you with it, but maybe I've been going about it all wrong this whole time.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Maybe… if I use it on myself instead…

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: Love… I promise…

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: I'll make this right… we'll be together again soon.

parts.speaker: limerence
parts.dialogue: I just… need…
